description.zh: 报警联系人分组ID。可以同时查询多个联系人分组ID，联系人分组ID之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The ID of the alert contact group. You can query multiple alert contact groups at a time. Separate multiple group IDs with commas (,).
The name of the alert contact group.

description.zh: 报警联系人ID。可调用SearchAlertContact接口来查询联系人ID，请参见[SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~)。
description.en: The ID of the alert contact. You can call the SearchAlertContact operation to query the contact IDs. For more information, see [SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~).
The name of the alert contact.

description.zh: 是否返回联系人分组中包含的所有联系人。默认不返回所有联系人。
description.en: Specifies whether to return all alert contacts in the queried alert contact group. By default, not all alert contacts are returned.
The ID of the region. Default value: `cn-hangzhou`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms search-alert-contact-group --contact-group-name TestGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --contact-name John_Doe --contact-id 123 --contact-group-ids 746 --is-detail true --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms SearchAlertContactGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ContactGroupName TestGroup --ContactGroupIds 746 --IsDetail true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ContactId 123 --ContactName John_Doe
